text:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run an onboarding perf bench for sapphire-7b-v1? We want to add it to the hosted catalog next week. Need p50/p95 latencies for seq=1k and seq=8k, steady-state tokens/s, peak GPU memory, and a note on whether KV-cache tiling helps. Run fp16 and int8 static quant. Batch sizes: 1, 4, 16. Please post a short digest + raw numbers. Thanks!

josh: Assigning to @ankit. Can you pick this up today? :wave:

ankit: On it. I’ll run smoke + steady-state on g5.48x and g5.12x. Any SLO targets? Also need the prompt set to mirror our short/long workloads.

maria: SLOs: p95 < 350ms at batch=1 for 1k seq; p95 < 1.2s for 8k seq. Prompt set: short-convo (avg 60 tokens) and long-doc summarization (avg 3k tokens). Dropping a small sample below.

maria: sample prompts: 
- "Summarize the following support thread in 3 bullets..." (short)
- "Given this 3000-token article, produce a 5-paragraph executive summary and list open questions." (long)

ankit: Cool. Starting now. I’ll post a quick summary here when steady-state runs finish.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary worker pool provisioned for sapphire-7b-v1 on g5.48x (job 87912). Logging enabled.

ankit: Results (g5.48x, fp16) — smoke + steady-state (300s), warmup 60s. No OOMs, minor p95 jitter during warmup.

```
config: fp16, batch=1, seq=1k
p50: 42ms
p95: 310ms
tokens/s (steady): 1800
GPU mem peak: 13.4GB
KV-cache tiling: +12% throughput vs baseline

config: fp16, batch=1, seq=8k
p50: 210ms
p95: 980ms
tokens/s (steady): 1500
GPU mem peak: 18.9GB

config: int8, batch=1, seq=1k
p50: 48ms
p95: 350ms
tokens/s: 1700
GPU mem peak: 10.8GB
notes: int8 yields ~8-12% perf drop but saves ~3-4GB memory; good for denser packing
```

ankit: Batch scaling (fp16): batch=4 improves tokens/s ~3.6x but p95 increases ~1.4x; batch=16 gives ~10x throughput vs batch=1 but p95 hits ~1.4s for 1k seq. For 8k seq large batches push memory near limit on g5.48x.

josh: Can you also run the same fp16/int8 configs on g5.12x so we have a lower-cost baseline?

ankit: g5.12x summary (fp16, steady):

```
config: fp16, batch=1, seq=1k
p50: 58ms
p95: 420ms
tokens/s: 1200
GPU mem peak: 12.6GB

config: fp16, batch=1, seq=8k
p50: 290ms
p95: 1.25s
tokens/s: 950
GPU mem peak: 17.8GB

config: int8, batch=1, seq=1k
p95: 480ms
tokens/s: 1100
GPU mem peak: 9.9GB
```

Note: g5.12x doesn't meet the 8k p95 SLO at batch=1 (1.25s > 1.2s).

claire: Thanks — that helps. Action items: (1) add these perf numbers to the model-catalog draft, (2) add int8 and fp16 quant profiles to the model repo, (3) schedule a canary rollout (2% traffic) on Hosted next Tue. Can someone open tasks?

maria: I’ll create a release board card and request eval runs for safety/QA. @ankit can you upload the full logs and perf artifacts (traces, histograms) to the bench artifacts bucket and link the PR?

ankit: Uploaded artifacts and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/312 — bench results, quant profile, and a short README. Also added perf histograms and raw logs to gs://redwood-bench/sapphire-7b/1769998888/

ops-bot: canary-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-25T14:00Z, 2% traffic. Observability hooks attached.

hana: Quick note — regression check: run the sess-eviction tracer for 10m during steady-state (we saw minor eviction in prior onboarding). @ankit can you attach that trace?

ankit: Good call. Ran sess-eviction tracer in the g5.48x run; attached trace file in artifacts and added a short note in the PR. Eviction events were <1/min and didn't correlate with p95 spikes.

josh: Nice work. Next steps: Claire to update catalog copy, Maria to create release card + evals, Ankit to monitor canary and post a 24h and 48h update. If no regressions, promote to catalog. :thumbsup:

maria: Sounds good. Thanks everyone for the quick turn. I’ll grab the model entry and draft the catalog blurb.

ankit: Will monitor the canary and share dashboards. Ping me if you want deeper perf counters.

josh: Closing loop here — leaving the thread open until 48h after canary.
